Used as a tantric ritual tool or protective amulet. Worn as lucky charm or talisman. Comes in black thread to hang around neck. It can be changed into leather chord for more style. 
The phurba (Tibetan: ཕུར་པ or ཕུར་བ, Wylie: phur ba; alternate transliterations: phurpa, phurbu, purbha, or phurpu) or kīla (Sanskrit Devanagari: कील; IAST: kīla) is a three-sided peg, stake, knife, or nail-like ritual implement traditionally associated with Indo-Tibetan Buddhism, Bön, and Indian Vedic traditions. This arrangement highlights the numerological importance and spiritual energy of the integers three (3) and nine (9).

items.title: Must read Karl Marx Friedrich Engels The Communist Manifesto Most Influential Political Manuscript
items.description: The 1848 pamphlet that Marx and Engels called the history of all society as a history of class struggle became one of the most influential political texts ever written. Commissioned by the Communist League, it lays out a sharp analysis of capitalism and the class conflict it creates, and became the founding document of a movement that reshaped the twentieth century. A short, essential read for anyone interested in political history, philosophy, or economics. 3.69 stars on Goodreads. #politicalphilosophy #karlmarx #classicnonfiction

items.title: investigation Mark Frost The Secret History of Twin Peaks NYT Bestseller From The Show's Co Creator
items.description: Written by the co-creator of the cult classic series, this New York Times bestselling dossier novel unearths decades of buried Twin Peaks lore, from Lewis and Clark expedition journals to the fate of Laura Palmer. Structured as a secret file of letters, UFO reports, and FBI case notes, it was released to prime fans ahead of the Showtime revival. 3.96 stars on Goodreads. Essential reading for any true Twin Peaks obsessive. #twinpeaks #cultclassic #davidlynch
